items.englishText: Increases throw efficiency when using a parabolic throw.
items.koreanText: 포물선 던지기 시 투척 효율이 증가합니다.

items.englishText: Throw efficiency increases by 10% for every 1 unit of distance.
Based on 5 units distance. Max throw efficiency (+50%) at your feet, decreases as distance increases.
